historical_source.experiment_difference: The user confirmed restoration of the historical quadratic term; actual hydrogen cost is added for this new comparison. This is not an L1 coefficient or a restored complete historical experiment.

terminal_rule: Use each real load interval's actual FC change and SOC once. Zero-duration shutdown and cycle settlement remain in the physical economic ledger and add no extra reward term.
accounting_scope: Complete FC/battery degradation and signed battery-equivalent hydrogen accounting are retained for comparison, but excluded from this training reward. Auxiliary FC/SOC penalties are not physical economic costs.
